name: trama
description: See your System as a layered Model of state machines, review Proposals and Drifts, and steer your coding agent from one editor tab.

commands.title: Send to agent (closing the tab sends it too)

trama.theme.markdownDescription: Colours of the Trama panel. Auto (the default) follows the editor's theme; Light and Dark fix it.

trama.ompPath.markdownDescription: Path of the `omp` program Trama runs for every agent, the model list and the checks. Empty looks for `omp` in the editor's PATH, then in `~/.bun/bin` and `~/.local/bin`.

enumDescriptions: A terminal tab in the active editor group.
trama.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where `omp` terminals open: `panel` (the terminal area; the default) or `editor` (a tab in the active editor group).

trama.ignoreInstructionFiles.markdownDescription: Trama's jobs ignore agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .omp/RULES.md) in the project and your user folders. Off by default.

trama.analysis.markdownDescription: Model for design work: design requests, Resolve Drifts and import. Empty (the default) keeps the agent's default model.

trama.scan.markdownDescription: Model for scans and the sub-agents that compare Machines, also in each Run's pre-flight. Empty (the default) keeps the agent's default model.

trama.execution.markdownDescription: Model for implementing Tasks, in single runs and Run all. Empty (the default) keeps the agent's default model.

trama.autoExit.markdownDescription: Close the agent's terminal as soon as the agent is idle or its command ends, and ask the agent to skip its final summary (default on).

trama.maxParallelAgents.markdownDescription: How many sub-agents the agent may run at once (default 20). Agents without sub-agents ignore it.

trama.skillsDir.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the project root, where Trama installs the agent skills.

trama.language.markdownDescription: The language the agent writes tasks, drifts, proposals, questions and replies in, for example `Italian`. The Model, Requirements, Specs and code stay in English. Empty (the default) keeps English.

trama.systemCertificates.markdownDescription: On: omp and your agent's commands trust the certificates your system trusts, for proxies that inspect HTTPS. Replaces `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, `SSL_CERT_FILE` and similar variables.

trama.advisorScanner.markdownDescription: On (the default): during every Run an advisor, using the Scan model, checks the code against the Model and files Drifts; the Run does not scan. Scan System still works.

trama.parallelExecution.markdownDescription: On (the default): in a run of several Tasks the agent may start together Tasks that concern the same thing, giving a reason.

trama.asyncDriftResolver.markdownDescription: On (the default): the agent prepares each Drift's resolution question, so `Resolve` asks it at once without starting an agent.

trama.subagentsContextSharing.markdownDescription: On (the default): the agent passes its sub-agents what it has already read about their work, so they do not read it again.

trama.autoUpdateStaleProposals.markdownDescription: On (the default): a stale design Proposal shows `to refine`; Approve adapts it to the current Model and then approves it.

trama.ompChat.markdownDescription: Trama's jobs open a conversation in the omp Chat view instead of a terminal.

enumDescriptions: omp asks permission as in the terminal: each request shows in the conversation and waits for your choice.
omp runs every command without asking, even those it would ask about in the terminal.
trama.ompChatApproval.markdownDescription: `yolo` (the default): omp runs every command without asking, even those it asks about in the terminal. `ask`: omp asks permission as in the terminal.

trama.ompChatIntentTracing.markdownDescription: On: in omp Chat the agent writes why it calls each tool. Off saves tokens. Applies to conversations started afterwards.

trama.ntfyServer.markdownDescription: Server that receives Trama's notifications. The default is the public ntfy.sh.

trama.ntfyTopic.markdownDescription: Topic for a notification when omp Chat jobs finish or wait for you. Empty (the default) sends nothing; on ntfy.sh anyone who knows it can read them.
